verdict.rationale: Latham & Watkins ships its own software tools through LathamDrive, including a document generator and an interactive glossary with apps. That makes API parity a fair question for this product. However, the evidence shows no public API, and probes for OpenAPI and llms.txt paths all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
